name: Julius Caesar
overview: Scripture teaches a balanced view of earthly authority and divine sovereignty through the interactions surrounding Julius Caesar. Jesus acknowledges the legitimacy of paying tribute to earthly rulers, as seen when He instructs to 'render therefore unto Caesar the things which are Caesar's; and unto God the things that are God's,' emphasizing the distinction between obligations to government and to God. The questions posed to Jesus about giving tribute highlight the importance of discerning lawful submission to civil authorities while maintaining ultimate allegiance to God. Proverbs further instruct believers to respect both the Lord and the king, warning against involvement with those who are unstable or rebellious.
